## Change

Describe the user-visible problem or new interaction and the resulting behavior.

## Interaction and distribution

For component changes, name the existing pattern followed and any intentional differences. Note text/layout continuity, interruption, keyboard/focus, reduced motion, and relevant async behavior. Confirm source/helpers/CSS/metadata/notices are included in the installable item.

For documentation-only changes, summarize the affected guidance instead.

## Validation

List the checks actually run and their results. Include relevant browser scenarios or frame evidence for visual changes. Explain any blocked/unrun checks.

See [the component brief](../docs/templates/component-brief.md) and [verification guide](../docs/verification.md).
